class.name: G4MFFileReference4D
class.brief_description: Represents a G4MF's reference to a file, which may contain data such as images, models, audio, or any other type of file.
class.description: G4MFFileReference4D is used whenever G4MF files need to reference data that could be found in an external file, such as an image file, model file, audio file, or any other file. All file references are required to define the file's MIME type, and may refer to stored data either in a buffer view or an external file URI. Export preparation assigns a unique [member Resource.resource_name] when the file reference has no item name. The name is derived from its preferred output path stem, its URI filename without the extension, or its index in the containing state's file references. Characters disallowed in item names are sanitized. Existing names are preserved. This name identifies the file reference independently of its URI and remains available when the data is embedded.

method.name: export_create_missing_directories_if_needed
method.description: Creates any missing directories in the filesystem needed for writing to the external file URI specified by this file reference's [member file_uri]. If [member file_uri] is an empty string, this does nothing and returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. If the directories already exist, this does nothing and returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. If the directories do not exist, it attempts to create them and returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] on success, or an error code on failure.

method.name: export_store_file_bytes
method.description: Stores bytes in the internal cache without writing them. Call [method export_write_to_buffer] or [method export_write_to_file] to write the cached bytes.

method.name: export_write_to_buffer
method.description: Writes the cached bytes into a buffer view in [param g4mf_state], then updates [member buffer_view_index]. The alignment, deduplication, and destination buffer arguments are passed to [method G4MFBufferView4D.write_new_buffer_view_into_state].

method.name: export_write_to_file
method.description: Writes the cached bytes to the nonempty [member file_uri], resolved against the parent state's base path. A relative URI requires an absolute base path, including [code]res://[/code] or [code]user://[/code]. Missing directories are created as needed. On success, [member buffer_view_index] is reset to [code]-1[/code].

method.name: import_read_file_data
method.description: Reads the file bytes from [member file_uri] or [member buffer_view_index]. With [param read_from_cache] enabled, previously cached bytes are reused. Otherwise the source is read again and the cache is refreshed.

method.name: read_file_reference_entries_from_dictionary
method.description: Reads general G4MF file reference properties from the given [Dictionary] and apply it to this file reference object. This function wraps around the [method G4MFItem4D.read_item_entries_from_dictionary] method, so it considers the [code]"name"[/code] and [code]"extras"[/code] keys, and additionally considers the [code]"bufferView"[/code], [code]"mimeType"[/code], and [code]"uri"[/code] keys.

method.name: resolve_file_uri
method.description: Resolves a filesystem [member file_uri] against [param base_abs_path]. Absolute paths, including [code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code], Windows drives, and network shares, are returned unchanged. Relative paths require an absolute [param base_abs_path] and are joined onto it. A missing or relative base for a relative URI returns an empty string with an error. An empty [member file_uri] returns an empty string.

method.name: sanitize_file_extension
method.description: Returns a lowercase extension containing only ASCII letters, digits, and dots. Disallowed characters are removed, and a trailing dot is replaced with an underscore. Preserves whether the input includes a leading dot and supports multipart extensions such as [code]tar.gz[/code]. If [param print_warning] is [code]true[/code], changes to disallowed characters print warnings.

method.name: sanitize_file_path_uri
method.description: Returns a sanitized filesystem path URI with lowercase snake_case directory and file names, preserving digit attachment. Converts backslashes and resolves redundant separators and dot segments. Filesystem roots, including [code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code], drive letters, and network server/share names, retain their spelling. Unresolved leading [code]..[/code] segments are preserved for relative paths. Replaces characters disallowed in filesystem path URIs and avoids Windows reserved names. Rejects paths naming only a directory, traversing above a root, or using a non-filesystem URI protocol, returning an empty string with an error. Empty input returns an empty string. If [param print_warning] is [code]true[/code], sanitation warnings are printed. This does not reserve the path or check uniqueness.

method.name: set_unique_file_path_uri
method.description: Sanitizes, reserves, and assigns a unique filesystem [member file_uri] using the non-null [param g4mf_state]'s shared path context. Splits the filename at its first dot so multipart extensions remain together when resolving collisions: [code]archive.tar.gz[/code] becomes [code]archive2.tar.gz[/code] if needed. Releases this reference's previous owned path reservation, while preserving independent reservations. Empty input clears the URI and releases ownership. Invalid input leaves both unchanged. See [method G4MFState4D.assign_unique_path_uri_from_stem] to supply a filename stem and extension separately.

method.name: write_file_reference_entries_to_dictionary
method.description: Base function for converting file references to a [Dictionary]. This function wraps around the [method G4MFItem4D.write_item_entries_to_dictionary] method, so it handles setting the [code]"name"[/code] and [code]"extras"[/code] keys, and additionally sets the [code]"bufferView"[/code], [code]"mimeType"[/code], and [code]"uri"[/code] keys. If implementing a custom G4MF file reference in script, this can be used as the start of a [code]to_dictionary[/code] function.

members.member: The index of the [G4MFBufferView4D] that contains the data for this file reference. If this is set to [code]-1[/code], then the file reference does not refer to a buffer view. This property is mutually exclusive with [member file_uri], so if this is set to a value other than [code]-1[/code], then [member file_uri] SHOULD be an empty string. If both are set, [member file_uri] takes precedence when the file exists.

The URI of the file relative to the G4MF file's location. If this is an empty string, then the file reference does not refer to an external file. This property is mutually exclusive with [member buffer_view_index], so if this is set to a non-empty string, then [member buffer_view_index] SHOULD be [code]-1[/code]. If both are set, [member file_uri] takes precedence when the file exists. File names SHOULD use snake case and all lowercase letters to avoid case sensitivity issues across platforms. Setting this property normalizes filesystem file and directory names to lowercase snake_case without inserting separators next to digits. General protocol and data URIs are preserved. URIs read by [method read_file_reference_entries_from_dictionary] retain their original spelling so existing files can be loaded on case-sensitive filesystems.

The MIME type of the file being referenced. This is a required property, and must be a valid MIME type string, such as [code]"image/png"[/code] for PNG images. When a file format's media type is registered with IANA, this MUST match the media type string as registered with IANA. When a file format's media type is not registered with IANA, any placeholder name may be used pending registration.
